lessons.claim: The fastest bending mode of a stiff chain may not be overdamped. In chain-bend, τ_p/τ_fast=0.60 -- BD treats that mode as overdamped. Being 4570x away from the observation band (τ_chain) it looks as though there is no effect on G'(ω), but that was not confirmed
